_comment: Failure labels (findings.py) the requirement-severity tests are known to fail with at the head they were last run against.
Used only with PPDS_DIFF_XFAIL=1: a test whose failures all carry these labels is reported as xfail.
A failure with any other label, or 'unlabelled', still fails. Remove a label when its fix lands.
Mode tags (r5-mode-*) are not listed: they name where a failure happened, not what it is, so a failure
is excused only by its class labels (a failure with a mode tag alone still fails).

labels.r5-env-who-on-unlisted: round 5: env who passes with an unlisted active environment, but it sends WhoAmI there (kept until the maintainer's ruling)
